_help: Numbers and lookups that cannot be derived from the page data. Edit here, then run: python scripts/build_all.py
_pre_lab_journal_count: Journal articles by lab members before the lab's 2018 start; shown as the footnote under the home-page journal stat.
_coauthor_countries: [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, name] for every country with a paper co-author. Add one when a paper brings in a new country; the order is the order of the flags.
_country_iso: Country name (as written last in a visitor's affiliation) -> ISO code, for the flag icon. Add an entry when a visitor from a new country is added.
